chunks: Muhammad ibn Ahmad al-Shaybani (may Allah be pleased with him) said: Muhammad ibn Abu Abdillah al-Kufi said, that Musa ibn Imran al-Nakha'i narrated from his uncle al-Husayn ibn Yazid al-Nawfali, from Ali ibn Salim, from Abu Basir, who said: Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said:
Verily, Allah, Blessed and Exalted be He, has forbidden Hellfire to the bodies of the monotheists.
ai.seo_question: What is the reward for monotheists regarding Hellfire according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this narration from Shaykh al-Saduq’s *al-Tawhid*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) highlights the specific divine promise that the physical bodies of true monotheists are spared from the fire, distinguishing them from those whose faith is merely verbal. This concept is central to Shia eschatology, where *tawhid* is understood not just as belief but as a transformative state that preserves the believer's essence from eternal punishment, reinforcing the interplay between faith and divine mercy.
